reuse.why: Holiday moving is threaded through the existing applyWeekendRule/applyWeekendRuleToDay/getDateWithSkippedWeekend chain, but the schedule-template site reads holidays from a schedule.data path instead of the config field its siblings use.

duplication.why: The move rule is written once, but the daily-skip half is added by repeating 'exdates: getHolidayExdates(config)' at all four hand-built RSchedule constructions instead of in one schedule factory.

placement.why: Holiday logic sits in shared/schedules.ts next to the weekend rule; the recurrence-building knowledge (which exdates to add) is still spread over server modules.

scope.why: Only the holiday feature, its type field and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Any new RSchedule construction must remember to add holiday exdates, and the inconsistent holidays lookup in schedule-template shows how easily a site drifts.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Callers use applyWeekendRule/applyWeekendRuleToDay; no site re-implements the move.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated RSchedule-with-exdates construction is copied openly, not reshaped.

one_place.where: Moving lands in getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but skipping depends on each of four RSchedule constructions (rule-utils, app.ts x2, find-schedules) passing getHolidayExdates, and schedule-template.ts feeds holidays from dateConditions.value.schedule?.data?.holidays rather than the config field.
